title: Three-Phase Voltage Source Inverter
text: Three-phase voltage source inverter, 7 inputs, 3 outputs; {Input inverter temperature} sets the create input port, {Enable memory optimized 2D LUT} sets the selection, {Calibrate Maps} sets the calibrate tables with measured data, {Switching voltage function} sets the selection Commanded phase, {Breakpoints for speeds (w), w_eff_bp} sets the speed breakpoints, {Resample storage size for w_eff_bp, n1} sets the speed bit size, {Breakpoints for load input (T), T_eff_bp} sets the torque breakpoints, {Resample storage size for T_eff_bp, n2} sets the torque bit size, {Breakpoints for temperature input, Temp_eff_bp} sets the temperature breakpoints, {Corresponding power loss, ploss_table} sets the 2D lookup table, {Corresponding power loss, ploss_table_3d} sets the 3D lookup table M -by- N -by, {w_eff_bp max endpoint, u1max} sets the speed breakpoint, {w_eff_bp min endpoint, u1min} sets the speed breakpoint, {T_eff_bp max endpoint, u2max} sets the torque breakpoint and {T_eff_bp min endpoint, u2min} sets the torque breakpoint. Values come from the instance.
